  sender: Harbour Master E. Lowe
  date: 15 March 1931

Dear friends,

The light of Gull Rock was dark last night, and {{object:great-lens}} is gone. Three people could have taken it: {{char:ana-ruiz}}, {{char:felix-ward}}, and {{char:maud-price}}.

{{char:tom-bell}} has sent me his logbook and his papers. Read them with care. Tell me who took the lens, and why.

::: handwriting
E. Lowe
:::
